critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~950 lines — should be split into routers/{auth,otp,customer_pin,menu,orders,stats,subscription,settings,profile}.py. Carry-over from prior iterations.

db.otps uses a single document with key='pin_reset' (singleton). Acceptable for single-manager demo; in a multi-tenant build it should be keyed by manager_id and use Mongo TTL index for auto-expiry (currently expiry is checked at read-time only — stale docs accumulate if never re-requested).

OTP single-use is enforced via delete after success (good), but a failed verify (wrong otp/wrong phone) leaves the OTP usable — there is no attempt counter, so brute-force of 1 in 1,000,000 is possible within 5 min. Consider adding an attempts field that invalidates after 5 failures.
Customer.jsx is now ~400+ lines — still mixing PIN gate, cart, drawer, stepper inline UI. Suggest extracting <CustomerMenuCard/> with its own qty state.

ForgotPinDialog.jsx — demo_otp toast leaks the OTP to anyone on the device. Production build should hide this and rely on SMS; ensure the demo_otp field is stripped before production deploy (use env flag DEMO_MODE).
test_credentials: Manager PIN 1234, Customer PIN 1234, Manager phone 9876543210 — all confirmed working and restored after tests.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data. Test temporarily mutated manager PIN to 8765 then 4567 during OTP/UI tests and restored back to 1234 at end of each suite. db.otps was created/cleared as part of normal OTP flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration-8 features verified working. Key data-testids: forgot-pin-dialog, forgot-send-otp, forgot-verify, pay-brands-{upi,card,netbanking,wallet} (.pay-brand-sym chips inside), sub-cycle-dates with .cycle-pill-start/.cycle-pill-end, profile-sub-dates with profile-sub-started-pill/profile-sub-ends-pill, profile-edit-btn (.profile-edit-btn-highlight), cust-add-<id>, cust-stepper-<id>, cust-qty-badge-<id> (text 'Added × N'), cart-fab (z-index 100001), kitchen-stats, kstat-new/active/cooking/delivered, kitchen-refresh-btn, kitchen-live-pill ('Live · 1s'). OTP flow: POST /api/auth/request-otp with {contact_number} returns {success,message,demo_otp}; POST /api/auth/verify-otp with {contact_number,otp,new_pin} returns {success}. demo_otp is intentional for demo build — production gating via SMS gateway not yet implemented. Single-use enforced by delete after success. Sales emoji fallback not visible because no top items today; verified via source (SalesSection.jsx:278).
rca of the issue: No issues found in iteration 8 scope. All features implemented and behaving per spec.
